description: Recording (a specific performance/track, distinct from the abstract work) by MBID: length, artist credits, ISRCs, the releases it appears on, the work(s) it performs (work-rels — chain to musicbrainz_get_work), and performance/production relationships (who played, produced, engineered, conducted — each with the role and the credited artist MBID). Relationships are capped at one page; for a heavily-covered recording call musicbrainz_browse_entities with target_type=recording and link.work.

inc_relationships.description: Include performance/production relationships (performers, producers, engineers) and work-rels.

name: musicbrainz_get_recording

items.description: One credited artist within an artist credit.

artistId.description: MBID of the credited artist — chain to musicbrainz_get_artist.

joinPhrase.description: Text that joins this credit to the next (e.g. " feat. ", " & "). Omitted when empty.

name.description: Credited name as it appears on the release (may be an alias).

artistCreditString.description: Display string of the artist credit with join phrases.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no recording exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: An external resource link (url-rel). Where cross-service IDs like Wikidata QID are surfaced.

resource.description: The external URL. Wikidata/Discogs IDs live in the URL path — chain to those servers.

firstReleaseDate.description: Earliest release date for this recording. Omitted when absent.

isrcs.description: ISRCs assigned to this recording (may be empty).

length.description: Recording length as m:ss. Omitted when unknown.

relationships.description: Performance/production relationships and work-rels (may be empty).

items.description: A typed relationship to another entity (band membership, performer, writer, etc.).

attributes.description: Role modifiers (e.g. "lead vocals", "assistant", "co"). Omitted when none.

begin.description: Relationship start date. Omitted when absent.

end.description: Relationship end date. Omitted when absent.

targetId.description: MBID of the related entity — chain to the matching get_* tool. Omitted for url targets.

targetName.description: Name/title of the related entity. Omitted when absent.

releases.description: Releases this recording appears on (may be empty).

items.description: A release this recording appears on.

country.description: Release country code. Omitted when absent.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get recording
